verdict.rationale: Docs confirm flags can be toggled without redeploying code (unleash-docs-18) and that Unleash Edge scales to thousands of connected SDKs (unleash-docs-5, unleash-docs-28), implying some form of live propagation, but there is no explicit documentation of streaming or fast-polling intervals, propagation latency in seconds, or a demonstrated 'kill switch' test confirming instant SDK effect. missing for 10: explicit polling/streaming interval docs, latency benchmarks, and a concrete kill-switch verification example.
